# SetModeler

Namespace `Nfty.Model` in assembly `Nfty.Model`.

```csharp
public sealed class SetModeler : IAssetModeler
```

Rises every asset of a cook into model files: [`StackDepth.ForAsset()`](Nfty.Model.StackDepth.md#m-forasset-nfty-core-formats-loadedrecipe-nfty-core-gene-9cba93) for the depth, [`Riser.TryBuild()`](Nfty.Model.Riser.md#m-trybuild-sixlabors-imagesharp-image-sixlabors-imagesha-c616c2) for the solid, [`ModelWriter`](Nfty.Model.ModelWriter.md) for the bytes.

## Remarks

Reads only — the book and the asset's picture are never mutated — so concurrent calls for different assets are safe and the bytes depend on the asset alone, at any thread count.

## Methods

### FileNames(string) { #m-filenames-system-string }

```csharp
public IReadOnlyList<string> FileNames(string baseName);
```

Every file name [`IAssetModeler.Model()`](../nfty-core/Nfty.Core.Output.IAssetModeler.md#m-model-nfty-core-generation-generatedasset-system-string) may return for an asset, derivable without building any model. The writer validates these for the whole Set before writing anything, then refuses a model file whose name was not declared here.

**Parameters**

- `baseName` (`string`) - The asset's zero-padded number.

**Returns.** The bare file names.

### Model(GeneratedAsset, string) { #m-model-nfty-core-generation-generatedasset-system-string }

```csharp
public IReadOnlyList<SetFile>? Model(GeneratedAsset asset, string baseName);
```

Files for one asset, named from `baseName` (`"0007"` becomes `"0007.glb"`), or null when nothing in it is fully opaque. Called concurrently for different assets, so it must be a pure function of its input.

**Parameters**

- `asset` (`GeneratedAsset`) - The finished asset.
- `baseName` (`string`) - The asset's zero-padded number.

**Returns.** The files, or null when the asset cannot be modeled.
